svg.text: The accessible endpoint fixes the propagation direction
p = τ − i a(t)η on η > 0; both models point toward increasing t.
Imaginary value is zero on the blue region and strictly negative on the green region.
Imaginary value is zero on the blue region and strictly negative on the green region.
A(t) = exp(−1/t²) for t > 0, and 0 for t ≤ 0. Zero sets and arrows are exact.
